sample_unit: deidentified breast and pancreatic cancer progress notes

links.outcome: LLM extraction errors from oncology notes: missing information and hallucinations
links.effect: GPT-4 average accuracy 68% on expert manual evaluation of a subset; common errors included partial responses with missing information and hallucinations with note-specific information.
links.quote: Common errors included partial responses with missing information and hallucinations with note-specific information.

screen.reason: The study develops a new expert-annotated clinical note dataset (CORAL) and benchmarks several LLMs on zero-shot oncological information extraction, focusing purely on model performance without evaluating an organizational deployment practice.
